== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Albadol Crane is a deceptive individual known for successfully infiltrating two different [[Imperial Guilds]] through forgery and false identities. He initially posed as a nobleman with formal training to deceive the [[Magisters]], escaping just before his fraud was discovered. He later spent five years within the [[Kanatalia]] [[Alchemists|alchemists]]' guild without being detected, though his tenure ended in calls for his arrest after the disappearance of several [[acolytes]] linked to his supposed miracle [[elixirs|elixir]]. Following his escape from the [[Alchemists|alchemists]], he relocated to an ancient castle in the [[Aurelian countryside]]. There, he conducted dark experiments that combined alchemical poisons with the [[Intent]] of a mad Reader. In his laboratory, Crane engineered massive, armored monstrosities constructed from human components. During confrontations, he has utilized a copper staff capable of discharging electrical sparks as well as firearms.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Albadol Crane was an alchemist who secured training under the [[Magisters]] by fabricating a noble lineage and a fake Academy education. After successfully deceiving these instructors, he joined the [[Alchemist's Guild|Guild of Alchemists]] in [[Kanatalia]]. His laboratory work involved constructing ten-foot monstrosities from human parts and experimenting with the combination of unhinged alchemical poisons and a mad Reader's [[Intent]]. Ultimately, Crane's deception of two [[Imperial Guilds]] was uncovered when his miracle [[elixirs|elixir]] appeared at the same time as the disappearance of several [[acolytes]], leading to his arrest and dismissal.}}
